tagline: STIHL equipment and expertise for Te Puke
heroSubheading: We stock and service STIHL equipment for everything from garden work to serious outdoor jobs.
aboutHtml:
We're Jeremy and Brad, and we run the STIHL SHOP Te Puke. We stock a full range of STIHL outdoor power equipment including chainsaws, trimmers, hedge cutters and blowers. Whether you're managing a lifestyle block, clearing storm damage, or doing regular garden maintenance, we've got the right machine for the job.

We don't just sell equipment. We service what we sell, so if something goes wrong you know where to come. We stock genuine STIHL parts and can help you maintain your equipment properly. Come in for advice on what suits your needs. We'll get you set up with gear that lasts.

Come see us Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm, or Saturday morning from 9am. We're here to help you get the work done.
servicesIntro: We service, repair and maintain STIHL equipment, keeping your gear running reliably.
